verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no general-purpose official iTerm2 CLI. It does show official command-line utilities such as imgcat and it2dl, which community users describe as shell-integration helpers, plus a Python package and AppleScript for scripting iTerm2 from outside the app. These are programmatic routes rather than a dedicated CLI. Missing for 10: a documented first-party CLI for controlling sessions, tabs and panes; first-party docs for the command-line utilities; any AI or agent-oriented CLI workflow.
